spans.s:
m. (-री)
A kite.
E.
वियत् the sky, and चारिन् who goes.

n. (-यत्)
Sky, heaven, ether, atmosphere.
E.
वि privative, यम to refrain or cease, aff. क्विप, and तुक् final.

m. (-तिः)
A bird.
E.
वि before यत to endeavour, कि aff.

f. (-ङ्गा)
The Ganges or river of heaven.
E.
वियत् heaven, गङ्गा the river.

f. (-तिः)
Moving in the air.
E.
वियत्, and गति motion.

f. (-तिः)
Darkness.
E.
वियत् the sky, and भूति superhuman power.

m. (-णिः)
The sun.
E.
वियत् the sky, and मणि a gem.

m. (-मः)
1 Forbearance, restraint.
2 Rest, cessation, stop.
3 Pain or distress of various kinds.
E.
वि before यम to check or restrain, aff. अप्; also वियाम.

m. (-मः)
1 Forbearance, restraint.
2 Rest, stop, cessation.
3 Pain or distress of various kinds.
E.
वि before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shameless, impudent, ill-behaved.
E.
वि implying prevention, and यात wished; wishing for what is prohibited or improper.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Separated, sundered.
E.
वि privative, and युक्त jointed.

m. (-गः)
1 Absence, separation, especially of lovers.
2 Disunion, disjunction.
E.
वि privative, and योग union.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Suffering separation.
E.
वियोग separation, भज् to serve, to be subject to, causal form, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Separated, absent, remote, apart.
m. (-गी)
The ruddy goose.
E.
वियोग separation, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Separated, disjoined, disunited.
2 Parted from, deprived of.
E.
वि privative, योजित joined.
